findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects (including the uploaded vendor-roster.xlsx) are stored unencrypted at rest by default, violating encryption-at-rest requirements for a reports archive.

This bucket stores ledger export data but defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial data unencrypted at rest, which is particularly risky for sensitive ledger/financial records.
Despite having versioning and access logging configured, the bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted at rest.
The operational runbooks bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving potentially sensitive operational documentation unencrypted at rest.
